concept.name: Driving Directions
concept.description: Twenty directional phrases a passenger or navigator might give a driver, arranged around a rotating steering wheel from straight-ahead (0°) through progressively sharper turns to full reverse (180°), mirrored left/right for visual symmetry. A discrete named-position concept, not a continuous spectrum — position encodes real-world steering-wheel geometry, not intensity.
concept.notes: Uses the CR-SW rotating-wheel architecture — unique among circular templates: vocabulary items are stored as an array of OBJECTS (not arrays), keyed by angle {a, tl, sl, (tlr), py, posA, dy}, with py/posA/dy being template-tuned label-placement offsets that must be preserved exactly from the generic template's own V array, not regenerated — only tl/sl/tlr should be substituted per position. Card rows below are given in the SAME fixed 20-item order as the generic template's V array so positioning metadata can be merged 1:1 by index. EN-ID vocabulary reused verbatim from the pre-existing populated instance (Steering_Wheel-Bahasa_Indonesia.html / registry-referenced as populated_instances/phonographic/ROM-CR-SW-EN-ID.html). EN-JA vocabulary newly generated 2026-07-11. v1.1 (2026-07-12): title_sl changed to "Which way?" (both pairs); EN-JA display_cycle changed from Japanese to English labels (Show-all button should read in SL, not TL/TLR, since it is a UI control not vocabulary content); UeyR ("Do a Uey") SL text simplified to "Turn around" in both pairs, with the Indonesian TL text's "(AUS/NZ)" slang annotation dropped to match (UeyL "Hang a Uey" intentionally left unchanged). v1.2 (2026-07-12): added title_tlr, instr_disappear_tlr, instr_body_tlr for EN-JA — the LOG-CR-SW template title and instructions panel only had TL/SL layers, missing TLR entirely (unlike vocabulary items, which already correctly implement the full TLR/TL/SL cycle). Template-level fix: title box converted from a 2-state hover-swap (TL default) to a proper 3-state click-cycle (TLR default, matching the vocabulary convention); instructions panel extended from 2-state to 3-state, SL kept as the default entry point (cycle: SL→TLR→TL→SL). App.html injection updated to pass through the three new fields for LOG templates.
